key.name: input-device
key.description: Identifier of the microphone used for new recordings; empty uses the system default input.

key.name: export-format
key.description: Format chosen by default when exporting: opus, m4a, mp3, flac or wav. Formats without an installed encoder are skipped.

key.name: playback-speed
key.description: Speed used when playing recordings, keeping the pitch.

key.name: transcription-language
key.description: Language code passed to the speech engine, or auto to detect it.
